name: Aikawa (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Aikawa town emblem in red: a disc divided by three white vertical strokes, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Aikawa, a town in Kanagawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 10 June 1952.

features.role: Aikawa town emblem — a disc divided by three white vertical strokes, like a stylised character
